newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 27.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 27.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- The European Union's (EU) enlargement will go according to the schedule set up before the Amsterdam summit, EU officials told the representatives of countries which plan to become members.
-- Ethnic Hungarian parties in Slovakia will appeal to international organisations because the Slovak government forbade schools to issue certificates in Hungarian language.
-- The National Bank of Hungary said that the new 10,000 forint notes would be legal tender from July 1.
-- Opposition parties continue to protest over the planned amendment of the law on land, saying the amendment would enable foreigners to buy land.
